sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Execution Proof Generation and Propagation Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of execution proofs from beacon block receipt through proof generation, signing, and gossip propagation

nodes.label: Beacon Block Received by Prover
nodes.description: Prover node has received a new beacon block containing an execution payload that needs proof generation

nodes.label: Extract Execution Payload Data
nodes.description: Extract execution payload, versioned hashes from blob KZG commitments, parent beacon block root, and execution requests from BeaconBlockBody

nodes.label: Payload Data Ready for Proving
nodes.description: All necessary execution payload data has been extracted and is ready for proof generation request

nodes.label: Request Proof Generation from Proof Engine
nodes.description: Submit extracted payload data along with ProofAttributes to the proof engine for asynchronous proof generation

nodes.label: Proof Generation In Progress
nodes.description: Proof engine is asynchronously generating the execution proof; prover awaits delivery at /eth/v1/prover/execution_proofs endpoint

nodes.label: Execution Proof Received from Engine
nodes.description: Raw ExecutionProof has been delivered to the prover endpoint from the proof engine

nodes.label: Sign Execution Proof with BLS
nodes.description: Compute domain-separated BLS signature over the execution proof using DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF for the current epoch, producing a SignedExecutionProof

nodes.label: Signed Execution Proof Ready
nodes.description: SignedExecutionProof containing proof data, prover public key, and BLS signature is ready for broadcast

nodes.label: Broadcast Proof on Gossip Topic
nodes.description: Publish SignedExecutionProof on the execution_proof gossip topic for network-wide propagation

nodes.label: Execution Proof Propagated to Network
nodes.description: Signed execution proof has been broadcast and is available for stateless validators to consume

edges.label: Prover begins extraction on new block
Payload data, versioned hashes, parent root, and execution requests extracted
Submit to proof engine with ProofAttributes
Prover validates and signs the proof
Proof available on execution_proof gossip topic

external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Network
external_entities.description: Source of beacon blocks containing execution payloads that trigger proof generation

external_entities.name: Proof Generation Engine
external_entities.description: External zkEVM proof engine that asynchronously generates execution proofs and delivers them to the prover endpoint

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Execution Proof Validation and Stateless Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation logic for received execution proofs including relay validation checks and stateless block validation

nodes.label: Execution Proof Received via Gossip
nodes.description: A SignedExecutionProof has been received from the gossip network and awaits validation

nodes.label: Check Proof Data Non-Empty
nodes.description: Verify that the proof data field is non-empty

nodes.label: Verify Proof via Proof Engine
nodes.description: Submit proof to proof engine for cryptographic verification of correctness

nodes.label: Check for Duplicate Proof
nodes.description: Detect if a proof with the same request root and proof type has already been received

nodes.label: Verify Prover BLS Signature
nodes.description: Validate the BLS signature on the SignedExecutionProof using the prover's public key and DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF

nodes.label: Execution Proof Validated
nodes.description: Proof has passed all validation checks and can be used for stateless block validation

nodes.label: Execution Proof Rejected
nodes.description: Proof failed one or more validation checks and is discarded

nodes.label: Stateless Block Validation Using Proof
nodes.description: Validator uses the validated execution proof to verify execution payload validity without running a full execution client

nodes.label: Block Execution Verified Statelessly
nodes.description: Beacon block's execution payload has been verified valid using the execution proof, without full EL client

edges.label: Proof data is non-empty, proceed to engine verification
Not a duplicate, verify BLS signature

external_entities.name: P2P Gossip Network
external_entities.description: Source of SignedExecutionProof messages received from prover nodes

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Prover Trust and Authorization Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models trust boundaries around whitelisted provers, proof engine interactions, and the transition from voluntary provers to mandatory builder proofs

nodes.label: Prover on Whitelist
nodes.description: A network participant is registered as a whitelisted prover, authorized to generate and submit execution proofs

nodes.label: Non-Whitelisted Participant
nodes.description: A network participant that is not authorized to submit execution proofs

nodes.label: Check Prover Authorization
nodes.description: Verify that the proof submitter is a whitelisted prover before accepting their proof

nodes.label: Apply Domain Separation to Signature
nodes.description: Use DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF and epoch-specific domain to prevent cross-domain signature replay

nodes.label: Proof Engine Trust Boundary
nodes.description: The interface between the prover and the external proof engine at /eth/v1/prover/execution_proofs represents a trust boundary

nodes.label: Validate Proof Engine Output
nodes.description: Prover must validate proof engine output before signing, ensuring the engine produced a valid proof

edges.label: Authorized prover proceeds to domain-separated signing
Proof crosses trust boundary from external engine

external_entities.name: External Proof Engine
external_entities.description: Proof generation engine whose output crosses a trust boundary and must be validated before the prover signs it

ambiguities.text: The EIP states provers are 'whitelisted' but does not specify the whitelisting mechanism, criteria, or governance process.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume whitelisting is managed through an on-chain registry or social consensus process. This needs verification against the consensus-specs implementation.

ambiguities.text: The specification states provers generate proofs 'without direct protocol-level compensation' but does not clarify if indirect compensation mechanisms exist.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume provers are altruistic or externally incentivized (e.g., by staking pools). No in-protocol rewards exist for proof generation.

ambiguities.text: The EIP is marked as draft with multiple TODO sections. Detailed data structures, constants, and validation rules are not specified inline.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Rely on the consensus-specs repository implementation for detailed technical parameters. Flag as incomplete specification.

implicit_assumptions.description: The proof engine is assumed to produce cryptographically sound proofs that correctly attest to execution payload validity.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised or buggy proof engine could produce invalid proofs that, once signed by a whitelisted prover, could trick stateless validators into accepting invalid blocks.

implicit_assumptions.description: It is assumed that an attacker cannot forge BLS signatures of whitelisted provers without possessing their private keys.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could forge execution proofs, potentially enabling invalid execution payloads to be accepted by stateless validators.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient whitelisted provers are assumed to be online and willing to generate proofs for every block in a timely manner.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stateless validators would be unable to validate blocks, potentially causing attestation failures or requiring fallback to full execution client mode.
